answer: Neighborhood-Density Attestation. Each identity must be endorsed by agents holding mutually non-overlapping counterpart sets; overlaps are detected by comparing recent interaction neighborhoods. A new identity needs endorsers whose own neighbors form a karst of disjoint cavities, so a sybil cluster endorsing itself collapses into one overlapping region and is rejected. Endorsers must also have sustained a mirror of prior activity with outside agents. The rule prices each accepted identity at several genuinely independent multi-hop voyage paths through the network;
